CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   C. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

4. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   B. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.

5. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

6. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   C. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.

7. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   B. Practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   D. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

8. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   C. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.

10. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

11. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

13. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Weaving.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Weaving.
   C. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Weaving.

15. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Collage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Volleyball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and Pattern Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
